description: Source code implementing WebSocket communication and gateway connection management for a client application. Includes protocols, actors, and methods for handling WebSocket sessions, authentication, reconnection logic, message framing, and request/response handling.

classes.name: WebSocketTaskBox
classes.description: A type-erased, Sendable wrapper for URLSessionWebSocketTask conforming to WebSocketTasking.

classes.name: WebSocketSessionBox
classes.description: A type-erased, Sendable wrapper for WebSocketSessioning.

classes.name: GatewayConnectOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for establishing a gateway connection, including role, scopes, permissions, client info, and device identity inclusion.

classes.name: GatewayChannelActor
classes.description: An actor managing WebSocket connection lifecycle, authentication, message handling, and reconnections for a gateway.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the gateway, handling authentication and response processing.

methods.name: startWatchdog
methods.description: Starts a background task to monitor connection health and manage reconnection attempts.

methods.name: keepaliveLoop
methods.description: Periodically sends keepalive pings to maintain NAT traversal and connection stability.

methods.name: handleConnectResponse
methods.description: Processes the response from the server upon connect, updating policies and storing tokens.
